messages:
alex: rolling out privnet egress-default-deny at 07:50 UTC; seeing GPU node bootstrap failures

maria: nodes hang on keystore decrypt step, kubelet logs show repeated TLS timeouts

sam: any proxy errors?

alex: keystore-proxy logs: "ERROR decrypt: tls handshake timeout (privatelink-lb 10.7.2.9)"

linh: conntrack alarm fired in az-b: natgw conntrack 86% at 07:48

ops-bot: ALERT natgw-az-b conntrack_usage=86% threshold=85%

tara: security changed outbound rules last night; privatelink is now the only path, LB seems overloaded

maria: consequence: privatelink latency spikes, failed handshakes fall back to NAT, NAT drops new flows due to conntrack, bootstrap loops

sam: mitigation options: 1) emergency SG open to keystore public IPs for 20m 2) scale privatelink pool 3) flip bootstrap to S3 envelope fallback

tara: I can approve a 20m SG exception with audit tag and ticket, need exact CIDRs

alex: propose scale privatelink proxies x3 + open 10.7.2.0/24:443 for 20m. scaling first to reduce blast radius

linh: HPA scaling started, but image pull throttling slowed pod startup; used local image cache to speed it

maria: after scaling + SG rule, decrypt timeouts dropped from ~70% -> ~11% in 6m, nodes started joining

sam: cost note: S3 envelope fallback costs ~0.45c/bootstrap * N; NAT upsizing costs more ongoing. SG rule is cheapest short-term

security-bot: ACTION_LOG sg-temp-20260321 created by tara at 07:56 UTC reason="gpu boot emergency"

tara: added audit-tag INC-2026-03-21-KE; SG TTL 20m

alex: followups: increase privatelink capacity, add client backoff + jitter to keystore client, document S3 fallback and test in staging, add decrypt p99 alert

linh: will add conntrack autoscale for NAT hosts and test LB headroom in staging

maria: add runbook entry: emergency SG flow, approvers (security oncall + infra lead), TTL and audit steps

sam: filing incident INC-2026-03-21-KP, will prepare cost comparison and timeline for permanent fix

ops-bot: INCIDENT_CREATED INC-2026-03-21-KP by sam at 08:10 UTC - keystore privatelink saturation -> gpu bootstrap failures

alex: good work. keep metrics on decrypt p50/p99 and conntrack over next 24h :thumbsup:
